excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: I have a question for Pyrsm and Teku on the `head_v2`, so per <@602753420033785856> 's idea (sorry for ping Michael) we wanna emit this twice a slot, once when we receive the block with `payload_status=empty` and if there is a payload later, we emit another with `payload_status=full`. When do client wanna emit the latter case, in lodestar for example, we do not recompute fork choice weight when we import the payload right away. And what makes it hard for me to reason about is because I don't exactly know what's the purpose of the second event with `payload_status=full` since for the validator client which is a consumer I understand pretty well, this second emit is completely useless.
